title: Every four-dimensional Kakeya set has full Hausdorff dimension
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We prove the four-dimensional Hausdorff-dimension Kakeya conjecture: every subset of ℝ4 containing a unit line segment in every direction has Hausdorff dimension four. No compactness or regularity assumption is imposed on the set or its witnessing line family.
